0022600038.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (7-4, 9th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-8, 12th in the West and 5th in the Southwest, 6 games back) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup, with Memphis 5-0 on the road and riding a 6-4 last ten, while New Orleans is on a four-game losing streak and 3-4 at home. The 2026-27 season series has Memphis trailing 0-1 after a 135-134 loss in Memphis on November 2, and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2. Memphis is without Richie Saunders (out, knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness), and Quinten Post is day-to-day with a head injury and a game-time decision, while New Orleans is without Trendon Watford (out, ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), and Bennedict Mathurin, Bryce McGowens and Trey Murphy III are day-to-day and game-time decisions with a thumb sprain, an elbow infection and knee tendinitis, respectively.
